name: comp-481
blurb: Table columns reorderable by dragging, with grip handles and sort controls.
description: Data table where column headers have drag handles to reorder columns horizontally. Each column can also be sorted via chevron button. Uses dnd-kit with horizontal-axis restriction and supports mouse, touch, and keyboard input.
use_when: Users need flexible column arrangement combined with sorting capability.
avoid_when: On touch-only devices — dragging columns feels awkward compared to native gestures.
a11y: Drag handles have aria-label "Drag to reorder". Sort buttons are keyboard-accessible. Drag also works via keyboard.
